mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 1% compresses equity discount rates by signaling accommodative monetary policy, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days without regime dependence.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not significantly positive (mean <= 0) in periods with FEDFUNDS < 1%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.3 percentage points signals labor market deterioration, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced consumer spending confidence.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >40% of instances with UNRATE 3-month change > 0.3pp, or signal Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in manufacturing output (INDPRO) and employment (PAYEMS) indicate broad economic contraction, driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days through earnings pressure.
failure_condition: Joint decline of PAYEMS and INDPRO fails to produce negative 20-day returns in >=60% of cases, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle expansions (indicated by housing starts above 1200k units), S&P 500 underperforms due to overvaluation and reduced growth momentum over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in >40% of late-cycle expansion periods, or signal Rank IC negative over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in industrial production (INDPRO > 105) signals robust manufacturing growth, supporting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO growth fails to correlate with positive 5-day SPX returns (mean <= 0) in majority of periods, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPI inflation exceeding 2.5% signals persistent inflation, prompting aggressive monetary tightening that drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in >40% of instances with CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5%, or signal Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS > 2.0%), higher discount rates reduce equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in >40% of FEDFUNDS > 2.0% periods, or signal Rank IC negative over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate weakening consumer demand, driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days through reduced corporate revenue expectations.
failure_condition: Joint decline of HOUST and RSAFS fails to produce negative 20-day returns in >=60% of cases, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year window.
